gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.

gaps.sentence: The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
There is no ___ (PROVE) that he was anywhere near the bank.
gaps.explanation: 'No proof that …' — the noun for evidence.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.

gaps.explanation: 'Highly suspicious' — the adjective for something that looks wrong.
'Needs revising' = needs to be revised — need + -ing.
